name: Nanao Castle
description: Nanao Castle was the 16th-century mountain stronghold of the Hatakeyama clan of Noto, built across seven hills. The ruins offer sweeping views of Nanao Bay and are a national historic site.
notes: Free open-air site; a scenic viewpoint road approaches the main bailey.

ja.name: 七尾城
ja.description: 畠山氏が能登を治めた七尾城。七つの峰にまたがる山城で、七尾湾を望む絶景と石垣が残る国史跡です。
ja.notes: 無料の野外遺構。展望道路で本丸跡まで車で行けます。
